statement: The function returns a result res and res = count(root), where size(Null)=0, size(Node v l r)=1+size(l)+size(r), sum(Null)=0, sum(Node v l r)=v+sum(l)+sum(r), and count(Null)=0, count(Node v l r) = [v = floor((v+sum(l)+sum(r))/(1+size(l)+size(r)))] + count(l) + count(r), with [P]=1 if P holds and 0 otherwise. Equivalently, res is the number of nodes n of root such that val(n) = floor(sum(s_n)/size(s_n)), where s_n is the subtree rooted at n.
preconditions: root is a binary tree with 1 <= size(root) <= 1000, where size(Null)=0 and size(Node v l r)=1+size(l)+size(r); every node value is an integer in [0,1000].

statement: The function returns a result res on root. Let m = mirror(root), where mirror(Null)=Null and mirror(Node v l r)=Node v (mirror r) (mirror l). Then the function returns the same result res on m; i.e., average_of_subtree(root) = average_of_subtree(m).

statement: The function returns a result res, and res = leaves(root) if and only if every internal node n of root (a node with at least one non-Null child) satisfies val(n) != floor(sum(s_n)/size(s_n)), where leaves(Null)=0, leaves(Node v Null Null)=1, and leaves(Node v l r)=leaves(l)+leaves(r) when at least one of l, r is non-Null, and s_n is the subtree rooted at n.
preconditions: root is a binary tree with 1 <= size(root) <= 1000, where size(Null)=0 and size(Node v l r)=1+size(l)+size(r); every node value is an integer in [0,1000].

statement: The function returns a result res and res = 1 + [v <= w <= v+1], where [P]=1 if P holds and 0 otherwise; explicitly, res = 2 when w is v or v+1, and res = 1 otherwise.
preconditions: root = Node v (Node w Null Null) Null or root = Node v Null (Node w Null Null), with 0 <= v <= 1000 and 0 <= w <= 1000.

statement: The function returns a result res and res = 1 + [w <= u <= w+1] + [2v <= w+u <= 2v+2], where [P]=1 if P holds and 0 otherwise.
preconditions: root is a chain of exactly three nodes with values v (the root), w (the only child of the root), and u (the only child of w), where each non-root node is the unique child (left or right) of its parent, and 0 <= v,w,u <= 1000.
